title: Grand Egyptian Museum

terrainReference.basis: Original public elevation in the Cairo-side entrance forecourt outside the facade.

mapIdentity.scope: The opened 2025 museum relation gives the 56-point main roof envelope and four-point inner opening. Original relief supplies the plateau and entrance context.

note: The architect explains five folded gallery bands and the sixth stair band connecting the shaded entry and plateau. The builder documents the 33,000 m² folded concrete canopy, 20 m cantilevers, 25 m ceilings and cable-supported glazing.
